testsuite.name: com.linecorp.cse.reqshield.KeyLocalLockTest

testcase.name: should cleanup multiple expired held locks without memory leak()
testLockCleanupEfficiency()
should handle concurrent operations from multiple instances safely()
expired-lock monitor removes entries from the shared lock map without any tryLock or unLock call()
should prevent concurrent lock acquisition after over-release attempt()
should not over-release semaphore on multiple unlock calls()
unLock with a foreign token returns false and keeps the lock held()
should share global lockMap across multiple instances()
testLockExpiration()
should cleanup expired lock even when unlock is never called()
testSharedSchedulerPerformance()
testConcurrencyWithOneKey()
testConcurrencyWithTwoKey()
at the cap tryLock still grants a permit but stops adding map entries()
should maintain request collapsing across multiple instances()
should allow different instances to unlock the same key via global lockMap()
should not remove lock that was just acquired during cleanup window()
should verify compute atomicity prevents TOCTOU race condition during concurrent cleanup and acquisition()
unLock removes the map entry right away instead of leaving it until expiry()
should not let an expired holder release the lock of the new holder()
